title: Understanding the Prevalence of Caste: A Critical Discourse Analysis of Caste-based Marginalization on X
reasoning: The paper extensively analyzes how religious symbols, scriptures (such as the Vedas and Manusmriti), and deities (like Ram and Parshuram) are used as rhetorical strategies to justify the caste hierarchy. It evaluates the intersection of religious authority and social power within the context of Hindu-centric discourse on social media.
